title: Colorado Small Claims Court (2026): Limit, Fees & How to File
rank_math_title: Colorado Small Claims Court (2026): $7,500 Limit & Fees
rank_math_description: Colorado small claims in 2026: $7,500 limit, $31/$55 fees, 2 claims a month, 15-day service, lawyer limits, 14-day appeals and 20% garnishment cap.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter -> county -> JDF 250 -> $31/$55 fee -> service 15+ days before trial (sheriff/process server) -> optional ODR mediation (JDF 75) -> trial (no jury) -> 14-day appeal -> JDF 252 interrogatories / garnishment (20% cap) / transcript of judgment
